name: e2e-permission-cycle
description: The whole loop with both shipped plugins: Orca tells plugin A an agent is working, then waits for a permission; A pushes it over the bridge to plugin B, the key shows it, a press focuses the pane through the runtime socket. Orca's own state is not changed, so only the push can move the key. Revert check: drop the workspace/agent forwarding in plugin A (createForwarder.onStatus).
